scenarios.name: Complete sample workspace
scenarios.description: Six fictional businesses, linked integrations, documents, underwriting, monitoring, exports, payment attempts and ledger entries.
scenarios.expected: Six businesses and associated records are available in the API and console.

scenarios.name: Within-policy underwriting
scenarios.description: Complete the borrower-to-risk-package journey with healthy synthetic cash flow.

scenarios.name: Outside-policy underwriting
scenarios.description: Run the same test policy against a business with lower cash receipts.

scenarios.name: Manual review
scenarios.description: Test a policy metric whose required source input is unavailable.

scenarios.name: Additional document required
scenarios.description: Pause underwriting with an actionable document requirement.

scenarios.name: Upload the missing document
scenarios.description: Run a missing-document flow and resume it with a real synthetic PDF upload.

scenarios.name: Source authorization required
scenarios.description: Pause a case until the borrower renews the requested source.

scenarios.name: Renew source authorization
scenarios.description: Complete the reauthorization Hub and resume underwriting.

scenarios.name: Borrower cancels connection
scenarios.description: Cancel a synthetic Hub session before consent.

scenarios.name: Borrower withdraws consent
scenarios.description: Revoke consent and confirm that normalized source content becomes restricted.

scenarios.name: Provider unavailable
scenarios.description: Exercise terminal processing failure without fabricating a risk package.

scenarios.name: Insufficient credit handling
scenarios.description: Pause an assessment and then resume it with simulated funding.

scenarios.name: Cash-flow deterioration
scenarios.description: Create a funded baseline, reduce synthetic receipts, and evaluate monitoring.

scenarios.name: Risk recovery
scenarios.description: Restore receipts after a deterioration and resolve the previous alert.

scenarios.name: Pause and resume monitoring
scenarios.description: Exercise monitor state changes and a new evaluation after resumption.

scenarios.name: Successful card top-up
scenarios.description: Post a simulated card payment and matching funding transaction.

scenarios.name: Declined card payment
scenarios.description: Create a failed test payment with no credit posting.

scenarios.name: Pending ACH top-up
scenarios.description: Record an ACH payment before settlement.

scenarios.name: ACH settlement
scenarios.description: Move an ACH payment from pending to succeeded and post its credits once.

scenarios.name: ACH returned
scenarios.description: Settle then return an ACH payment with a linked reversing ledger entry.

scenarios.name: Payment refund
scenarios.description: Post a payment followed by a full refund and linked immutable transactions.

scenarios.name: Automatic top-up
scenarios.description: Exercise a run-local low-balance trigger and an automatic simulated payment.

scenarios.name: Download reports and evidence
scenarios.description: Create JSON, PDF and CSV exports from the same risk package and evidence.

scenarios.name: Failed export
scenarios.description: Exercise the documented export failure state.

scenarios.name: Safe retries and conflicts
scenarios.description: Repeat a create request with the same key, then change its payload.
scenarios.expected: same resource on retry / 409 on conflict

scenarios.name: Invalid input
scenarios.description: Submit an invalid borrower request and inspect the structured error.

scenarios.name: Snapshot pagination
scenarios.description: Read a frozen page, create another borrower, and continue the original snapshot.
scenarios.expected: no duplicates / new record excluded from snapshot

scenarios.name: Signed webhook delivery
scenarios.description: Create a real Sandbox event and enqueue delivery to the selected Sandbox endpoint.
scenarios.expected: signed HTTP request / persisted delivery attempt

scenarios.name: Duplicate webhook delivery
scenarios.description: Replay the same persisted event twice to test deduplication by event ID.

scenarios.name: Out-of-order events
scenarios.description: Replay persisted resource versions in reverse order.
scenarios.expected: newer event replay queued before older event replay
